notes.title: Microsoft Maquette 2020.3.0.0.1315 Released
notes.content:
A new version 2020.3.0.0.1315 is available with the following changes:

[b]Stage as "AR Simulation" background[/b]
Made content in master stage treated as "background environment" in AR simulation mode. It is no longer clipped by the FOV and works in the same way as other room environments such as the "conference room".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34320290/ba3ab2f4df732eccb8cd79e5f484de35b1c003c9.png[/img]

[b]Grouping UX Improvement[/b]
Default group orientation is now following rotation of the child with the largest bounding box volume as a better heuristic than before.

[b]Teleportation UX Improvement[/b]
Changed teleportation to be activated by holding the "Grip" button on empty space with the non-dominant hand. This prevents accidentally activating teleportation when trying to grab objects. Swimming can still be activated as usual.
[previewyoutube=qhj5SLSCuj4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]New Procedural Object Type and Bug Fixes[/b]
Introducing a new "Capsule" procedural object type.
Fixed "rounded corner rim" procedural object not scaling correctly when using bounding box gimbal manipulator.

[b]Other Improvements and Bug Fixes[/b]
Made scene switch faster when there is a complex master stage.
Fixed exception thrown from keyboard and other detachable UI when exiting the app.
Added more images into the image library.

notes.title: (UPDATED 04/09/20) Microsoft Maquette 2020.2.1.0.1192 Released
notes.content:
** Update 04/09/20 **
The previous release of 2020.2.1.0 had a build issue that we have resolved. The current version is 2020.2.1.0.1192.

** Original post **
We have noticed increased number of unhandled exceptions leading to Maquette in unusable state. This release attempts to address crashes in the following code area:

- Maquette.Unity.MqTutorialController.SetHandednessUI
- Maquette.Unity.MqDetachableUI.UpdateUIParent
- Maquette.Unity.MqTutorialStep.Enter

We will continue monitoring crashes and make subsequent releases to attempt fixing them. Many of these errors are hard to reproduce and fix. We appreciate your patience and encourage you to share any useful bug reproduction information in our community channel.

Thank you for using Maquette!

tags.bug: - Maquette.Unity.MqTutorialController.SetHandednessUI
- Maquette.Unity.MqDetachableUI.UpdateUIParent
- Maquette.Unity.MqTutorialStep.Enter

notes.title: Microsoft Maquette 2020.2.0.0.1162 Released
notes.content:
[h3][b]New parametric objects[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=oQEKsDO5964;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] Introducing parametric objects based on parameters editable in the object's context menu.
[*] First set of parametric objects include:
   - Rounded corner objects
   - Rounded corner rim objects
   - Cylindrical objects
   - Conic objects.
[/list]

[h3][b]New spotlight featuring parametric objects [/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=8_TMWPUIfuQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] Named "Augmented City Farm". Accessible from the home space spotlight menu.
[/list]

[h3][b]Select tool improvement[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=MLarjKIplQg;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] Introducing an alternative selection mode. It can be turned on in the Settings menu.
[*] The new mode aims to provide a more streamlined way to do selection and deselection in the select tool. Feedback is welcome!
[/list]

[h3][b]Text tool improvements[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=0PSe0RR-0rk;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] Text is snapped to pointed surfaces automatically when the text tool is scaled down to needle mode.
[*] Added support to paste text into the selected text object from the OS clipboard.
[*] Added buttons in text tool menu to fill placeholder (Lorem ipsum) text to the selected text.
[/list]

[h3][b]Color picker improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added support to use the joystick to fine tune the cursor position.
[*] Added alpha channel slider to color pickers. Alpha value applies to additive and translucent materials.
[/list]

[h3][b]Tube brush improvement[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=VlkmRfRC8yM;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] Added support of a straight edge mode, accessible by holding down the B button while drawing.
[/list]

[b]Other improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved context menu placement algorithm.
[*] Allowed externally imported models to cast shadows.
[*] Combined consecutive slide switch actions in undo stack into one to save performance.
[*] Fixed some sporadic crashes and exceptions.
[/list]

notes.title: About issues in the last release (2019.6.0.0.831)
notes.content:
Hi Maquette users,

We have noticed some issues related to launching the latest release of 2019.6.0.0.831. Here are some suggested steps to resolve:

[b]I launched the app and can't click anything. The input controllers do not work.[/b]
A new setting in SteamVR input might have not propagated correctly after the app update. Try the following steps:
- Quit and restart Steam
- Right click Microsoft Maquette -> Properties -> Local Files -> Verify Integrity of Game Files
- Uninstall and reinstall Microsoft Maquette
- Update SteamVR to 1.8.20.

If it still does not work after the steps above, we'd like to hear from you to get more information. If you are blocked and needs to use Maquette right away, here is an alternative:

- In Properties, Opt into Beta branch named "2019.5.0.0.795".
- After installed, ONLY launch Maquette from the exe file located at "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Microsoft Maquette\Maquette.exe". Do not launch from Steam.

tags.bug: [b]I launched the app and can't click anything. The input controllers do not work.[/b]

notes.title: Microsoft Maquette Update 2019.3.0.0 Released
notes.content:
[h1]Beta Version 2019.3.0.0[/h1]
[b]Lighting, Gimbal Manipulation, Video Capture, & More[/b]
[i]Released June 4, 2019[/i]

Link: [url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-3-0-0][b]OFFICIAL RELEASE NOTES[/b][/url]

[url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-3-0-0][img]https://i.imgur.com/c9WHbxU.png[/img][/url]

[b]Bring Maquettes to Life With Lighting.[/b]
[list]

[url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-3-0-0][img]https://i.imgur.com/zhMrQR8.png[/img][/url]

[*] Maquette now supports real-time lighting, with point lights and spotlights which can be added to the scene. Lights can be created and managed within the Lighting tab of the Gizmos menu.
[*] In the Lighting tab, light gizmo UI visibility can be toggled with the checkbox at the top of the menu.
[*] Each light has several customizable properties, including color, intensity, shadow-cast behavior, spotlight angle, and more.
[*] Access a light's properties using its context menu. Hover your dominant hand's cursor on a light placed in the scene, and press the . . . button on your controller. You can alternatively access properties through the . . . button on the right side of the list of lights placed within the scene, found within the the Gizmo Menu's Lighting tab.
[/list]

Link: [url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-3-0-0][b]Watch the video on the Maquette site.[/b][/url]


[b]Place Content Perfectly with Gimbal Positioning.[/b]

[url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-3-0-0][img]https://i.imgur.com/lcuIEix.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*] Precisely edit the position, rotation, and scale of any content placed within the scene using the new gimbal handles.
[*] Access the gimbal by hovering on content, and pressing the gimbal button on your controller.
[*] Grab gimbal handles with the grip button to re-position content.
[*] To hide the gimbal again, press the check button on the controller.
[*] While moving a gimbal handle, use the trigger to stamp objects along individual axis or around specific rotations.
[*] Gimbal directionality can be re-oriented using the new Bounding Box Tool - more information below.
[/list]

Link: [url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-3-0-0][b]Watch the video on the Maquette site.[/b][/url]


[b]Use the Bounding Box Tool to Orient Grouped Content's Directionality.[/b]

[url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-3-0-0][img]https://i.imgur.com/iTij8YB.png[/img][/url]


[list]
[*] It's useful to change group's bounding boxes for better positioning when Surface Snapping & ﻿Rotation Snapping content, or for changing the orientation of gimbal positioning handles.
[*] When the gimbal is active, the Bounding Box Tool appears next to your dominant hand's controller, much like the Orientation Tool. Pick it up and use the trigger to orient grouped contents' bounding boxes to targeted content.
[/list]

[b]Take Steady-Cam Video & More With the New Camera Tool.[/b]

[url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-3-0-0][img]https://i.imgur.com/lVmheTt.png[/img][/url]


[list]
[*] New Camera Features Include Video Capture, Steady-cam, and Horizon Lock.
[*] Camera output can be set between photo, video, and 360 capture within the camera tool menu.
[*] The Camera tool now supports a horizon lock mode, adjustable steady-cam smoothing, and FOV adjustment UI.
[*] Now that the camera tool supports video capture, the video capture functionality from the Labs Menu has been removed.
[/list]
 
[b]Introducing Re-designed Hand-held Capture & First-Person Capture Modes[/b]

[url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-3-0-0][img]https://i.imgur.com/vNIC2VW.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*] Toggle between Hand-held Capture Mode and First-person Capture Mode within the Camera Tool menu.
[*] In First-person Capture Mode, a HUD visualization of the media capture area appears, making it clear which content will appear in the photo or video frame during capture. This capture area can be adjusted using the joystick or touchpad slider on the dominant hand, or by changing camera FOV in Hand-held Capture Mode.
[*] While recording in first-person video capture mode, you can leave the camera tool. You can end a recording while outside the camera tool with the red Stop Recording button at the bottom of the hand menu.
[/list]

[b]Preview & Delete Camera Captures Without Removing the Headset.[/b]

[url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-3-0-0][img]https://i.imgur.com/yxAFdBN.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*] Upon completing a photo, video, or 360 capture, a preview of the latest capture will appear. From the capture preview UI, the output media can be revealed in the desktop file explorer or deleted from the disk.
[/list]
 
[b]View Content's Properties with Context Menus.[/b]

[url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-3-0-0][img]https://i.imgur.com/RDmx3Vj.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*] All content placed in a scene can now be named and customized further with context menus.
[*] To open a context menu, hover your dominant hand's cursor on content placed within the scene, and press the . . . button on your controller.
[/list]

[b]Choose the Right Color With the Contextual Color Picker.
[/b]
[url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-3-0-0][img]https://i.imgur.com/QJoYyZo.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*] Selecting a color swatch within Maquette's UI now open a contextual color picker for precise color selection.
[/list]

[b]Additional Changes & Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Close floating Maquette UI by throwing it away.
[*] New Tutorials
[*] New Spotlight Content in the Home Space
[*] Spatial Audio
[*] Visual update to virtual buttons on Oculus Touch & Knuckles controllers.
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]

(Update: 2019.3.1.0.664)
* Fixed a bug where bounding box orientation changes get reverted upon saving.
* Fixed a bug occurring when camera mode is changed.

notes.title: Microsoft Maquette 2019.3.0.0.647 available in beta
notes.content:
(UPDATE) Microsoft Maquette 2019.3.0.0.647
[list]
[*] Gimbal orientation change is now undo-able.
[*] Fixed missing text rendering in 360 viewport orb.
[*] Fixed swimming lock when ungrabbing object with orientation tool still held in the other hand.
[*] Fixed message box scaling bug in camera capture preview.
[*] Fixed error when closing 360 preview with orb held in hand.
[/list]


(UPDATE) Microsoft Maquette 2019.3.0.0.645

[b]Bring Maquette to Life With Lighting
[/b]	

• Maquette now supports real-time lighting, with point lights and spotlights which can be added to the scene. Lights can be created and managed within the Lighting tab of the Gizmos menu.
	• While the Gizmo Menu's Lighting tab is selected, point lights and spot lights can be dragged into the scene from their preview boxes next to the Gizmo Menu.
	• In the Lighting tab, light gizmo UI visibility can be toggled with the checkbox at the top of the menu.
	• Each light has several customizable properties, including color, intensity, shadow-cast behavior, spotlight angle, and more.
	• Access a light's properties using its context menu. Hover your dominant hand's cursor on a light placed in the scene, and press the . . . button on your controller. You can alternatively access properties through the . . . button on the right side of the list of lights placed within the scene, found within the Gizmo Menu's Lighting tab.
Place Content Perfectly with Gimbal Manipulation
	• Precisely edit the position, rotation, and scale of any content placed within the scene using the new Gimbal handles within Gimbal Manipulation Mode.
	• Access Gimbal Manipulation Mode by pressing the Gimbal button on your controller, which appears while hovering it on a piece of content in the scene. Then, grab the handles with the grip button to re-position focused content.
	• To leave Gimbal Manipulation Mode, press the check button on the controller.
	• Objects can be stamped in lines along individual axis and around rotations by pressing the trigger button while moving an object with any of the gimbal handles.
	• Gimbal directionality can be re-oriented using the Orientation Tool. Pick it up by hovering it with your non-dominant hand's cursor and holding the grab button. Aim the ray at specific content and press trigger to orient the Gimbal's directionality to targeted content. Aim the Orientation tool in empty space to reset gimbal directionality to world rotations.

[b]Video Capture, Steady-cam, and Horizon Lock
[/b]	

• Camera output can be set between photo, video, and 360 capture within the camera tool menu.
	• The Camera tool now supports a horizon lock mode, adjustable steady-cam smoothing, and FOV adjustment UI.
	• Now that the camera tool supports video capture, the video capture functionality from the Labs Menu has been removed.

[b]Hand-held & First-Person Capture Modes
[/b]	

• Toggle between Hand-held Capture Mode and First-person Capture Mode within the Camera Tool menu.
	• In First-person Capture Mode, a HUD visualization of the media capture area appears, making it clear which content will appear in the photo or video frame during capture. This capture area can be adjusted using the joystick or touchpad slider on the dominant hand, or by changing camera FOV in Hand-held Capture Mode.
	• While recording in first-person video capture mode, you can leave the camera tool. You can end a recording while outside the camera tool with the red Stop Recording button at the bottom of the hand menu.

[b]Preview & Delete Captures Without Removing the Headset
[/b]	• Upon completing a photo, video, or 360 capture, a preview of the latest capture will appear. From the capture preview UI, the output media can be revealed in the desktop file explorer or deleted from the disk.

[b]Context Menus
[/b]	

• All content placed in a scene can now be named and customized further with context menus.
	• To open a context menu, hover your dominant hand's cursor on content placed within the scene, and press the . . . button on your controller.

[b]Contextual Color Picker
[/b]	

• Selecting a color swatch within Maquette's UI now open a contextual color picker for precise color selection.

[b]Additional Changes & Fixes
[/b]	

• Close floating Maquette UI by throwing it away.
	• New Tutorials
	• New Spotlight Content in the Home Space
	• Various bug fixes


---

(UPDATE) Microsoft Maquette 2019.3.0.0.602

We made a number of minor bug fixes and released today (May 2, 2019):

	- Fixed a bug where viewpoint avatar being invisible when it is grabbed
	- Fixed gimbal bounding box visibility at application launch
	- Fixed crash when taking picture in the camera tool while camera menu is not visible
	- Fixed NUS handle material initial visual inconsistency
	- Improved throwing to delete detachable UI sensitivity

---

Microsoft Maquette 2019.3.0.0.598

Thank you for your support and feedback!

We are beta testing a new release of Microsoft Maquette containing new features and improvements and also various bug fixes:

	• Introduced lights, which can be found within Gizmos.
	• Improved Orientation Tool, supporting bounding box calibration
	• Introduced Gimbal Manipulation. Hover on content, and press the gimbal button on the dominant hand controller 
	• Enhanced UI elements that keyboard and context menus are now throwable.
	• (Experimental) Introduced context menus for scene content. Press the trigger while touching something with the non-dominant hand's cursor.
	• Fixed various minor UI, viewpoint and environment bugs

Check it out by opting in beta and let us know of any issues or suggestions!

notes.title: Microsoft Maquette Update 2019.2.0.0 Released
notes.content:
[h1][b]Beta Version 2019.2.0.0[/b][/h1]
[i]Released April 3, 2019[/i]

Link: [url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-2-0-0][b]OFFICIAL RELEASE NOTES[/b][/url]

[url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-2-0-0][img]https://i.imgur.com/po64lmx.png[/img][/url]

[b]Surface Snapping[/b]

Link: [url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-2-0-0][b]Watch the video on the Maquette site.[/b][/url]
[list]
[*] Content can be snapped to surfaces in the scene using the surface snapping button, which appears on the controller when holding an object close to another object's surface.
[*] While an object is snapped, it can be rotated along the surface by holding the rotation button.
[*] Holding the surface snapping button locks the snapping plane.
[*] Content snapped onto a surface will stay snapped the next time it's picked up, so long as the surface below it is still in position.
[/list]

[b]Teleportation[/b]

Link: [url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-2-0-0][b]Watch the video on the Maquette site.[/b][/url]

[list]
[*] Holding the grip button in empty space enables locomotion controls. A teleport ray appears, and viewpoints become visible as target destinations.
[*]With the grip button held, press the trigger to teleport to the target destination.
[*]Teleporting resets your scale to 1:1. This can be disabled in the [*]Locomotion tab of the Settings menu.
[*]While holding the grip button, Left & right on the joystick or touchpad rotates your view in 45° increments, and up & down locomote you forward & backward.
[/list]

[b]The Orientation Tool[/b]

Link: [url=https://www.maquette.ms/release-notes-2019-2-0-0][b]Watch the video on the Maquette site.[/b][/url]

[i]Uses of the Orientation Tool[/i]
[list]
[*] While holding a piece of content with Rotation Snapping on, use the Orientation Tool to align Rotation Snapping to a targeted piece of content.
[*] Groups created within the Select Tool align their bounding boxes to the directionality set with the Orientation tool.
[/list]
[i]How to use the Orientation Tool[/i]
[list]
[*] The Orientation Tool appears on your dominant hand when moving content with Rotation Snapping on. Hover on it with your other hand and use the grip button to pick it up.
[*] While holding the Orientation Tool, press the trigger to activate it at targeted content. Activating the orientation tool at empty space will reset it.
[/list]

[b]360 Image Capture[/b]
[list]
[*] Within the Camera Tool, select the 360° button to toggle on and off 360° image capture mode. 360° 
[*] Output images appear with other screenshots in ~Documents/Maquette/Screenshots

[/list]

[b]UI Numpad[/b]
[list]
[*] Point at a number variable (i.e. RGB color) in Maquette's UI and select it with the trigger to invoke a numpad for numeric input.
[*] The Maquette numpad accomodates basic mathematical operations.
[/list]

[b]Dimensional Indicators[/b]
[list]
[*] Dimensional indicators display the measurement of object's bounding boxes when objects are picked up.
[*] These can be turned off within the UI tab of the Settings menu.
[*] Toggle the metric and imperial systems in the UI tab of the Settings menu.
[/list]

[b]Additional Changes & Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Clock behind menu
[*] Added floating tool tips
[*] Support for Knuckles controllers
[*]New 3D Geometric Primitives
[*]Visual update to Start Space environment 
[*]Various bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Microsoft Maquette Update Released
notes.content:
We have updated the general release of Maquette based on changes from our beta branch. The changes for this update include:
	
[b]Interaction[/b]
	[list]
[*]Improved swimming navigation algorithm with new swimming UI.
[*]Improved hover detection of non-uniform-scale gizmos.
[*]Eye dropper can pick color from images now.
[*]Loading screen in headset now animates.
